This decision, stemming from their third-place finish in the domestic league, sees the Cairo giants enter the CAF Confederation Cup instead.

Following a board meeting held on Saturday, July 25, the EFA confirmed that fierce rivals Zamalek and Pyramids FC will represent Egypt in the Champions League. While Al Ahly reportedly harbored hopes of a late return to the top-tier competition, particularly after news of Zamalek clearing outstanding debts to secure their own licensing, the final ruling places them in the Confederation Cup.

Al Ahly's last foray into the Confederation Cup was in 2014, a campaign they ultimately won. Joining them in the Confederation Cup will be Zed FC, who earned their spot after reaching the Egyptian Cup final last season. This shake-up promises an intriguing and competitive season for Egyptian clubs across the African continent.

articles.headline: New England Revolution Lands English Winger Jack Harrison in Marquee Deal
articles.summary: The New England Revolution has officially secured experienced English winger Jack Harrison, bringing him back to Major League Soccer on a long-term Designated Player contract. This significant acquisition sees Harrison depart Leeds United, adding considerable attacking prowess to the Revolution's roster.
articles.body:
The New England Revolution announced a major transfer coup yesterday, confirming the signing of Jack Harrison from English Premier League side Leeds United. The 29-year-old winger has committed to a Designated Player contract with the MLS club, extending through the 2029-30 season, pending final visa and international transfer clearances. This move marks a notable return to North American football for Harrison, who previously played for New York City FC.

Harrison brings a wealth of experience from top European leagues, having featured prominently in the English Premier League with both Leeds United and Everton, as well as a recent loan spell with Fiorentina in Italy's Serie A. His professional career spans over a decade, accumulating more than 375 appearances and contributing 54 goals and 50 assists across various competitions. His impactful performances, particularly during his time at Leeds where he helped secure a Championship title and Premier League promotion, highlight his capability to influence games at a high level.

Revolution General Manager Chris Tierney expressed that Harrison addresses a critical need to strengthen the team's offensive capabilities. Harrison himself conveyed his excitement about rejoining MLS and settling in Massachusetts, stating that the decision aligned perfectly with his career aspirations. He voiced his ambition to contribute to the Revolution's pursuit of a championship in a city renowned for its sporting successes.

articles.headline: Tottenham Begins Oceania Tour with Clinical Win Against Auckland FC
articles.summary: Tottenham Hotspur opened their pre-season tour of Oceania with a solid two-nil victory over Auckland FC today. The London club displayed controlled possession and effective finishing to secure their first win abroad.
articles.body:
Tottenham Hotspur kicked off their pre-season campaign in Auckland with a comfortable 2-0 triumph against local side Auckland FC. The match, played on July 26th, saw the Premier League outfit assert dominance from the outset, showcasing their preparations for the upcoming 2026/27 season.

The English side's disciplined performance ensured they kept a clean sheet while finding the back of the net twice. This result marks a positive start to their series of friendly fixtures as they continue their global tour before the domestic season commences.

The victory provides valuable match fitness and an opportunity for the squad to gel, particularly for any new additions, under the watchful eye of their coaching staff. Supporters will be encouraged by the professional display as the team builds momentum for the challenges ahead.

articles.headline: Five Teams Advance in Thrilling Women's Champions League Qualifiers
articles.summary: The UEFA Women's Champions League saw five clubs secure their spots in the second qualifying round after navigating intense mini-tournaments across Europe. Victories for Czarni Sosnowiec, Mitrovica, PAOK, Riga FC, and Spartak Myjava mark the initial steps in their European campaigns.
articles.body:
The opening phase of the 2026/27 UEFA Women's Champions League concluded today, as five teams successfully progressed from their respective first qualifying round mini-tournaments. Clubs from various nations battled it out, with the victors earning their place in the champions path of the second qualifying round.

Among the standout performances, Riga FC orchestrated an impressive comeback to overcome Wrexham, securing their first-ever advancement to the second qualifying round. Elsewhere, Poland's Czarni Sosnowiec triumphed over Athlone Town, while Kosovan side Mitrovica defeated Ludogorets.

PAOK also ensured their progression by beating Neftçi, and Spartak Myjava from Slovakia moved forward by overcoming Mġarr United in their final. These five teams now look ahead to the next stage, which will be contested in further mini-tournaments scheduled for early August.

articles.headline: Celtic Nears Club Record Deal for Danish Striker Kasper Høgh
articles.summary: Scottish champions Celtic are reportedly on the verge of securing a significant transfer for Danish forward Kasper Høgh from Norwegian side Bodø/Glimt, with a medical anticipated very soon. This substantial move aims to bolster Celtic's attacking options following a recent departure.
articles.body:
Celtic is reportedly closing in on a club-record signing with the acquisition of 25-year-old Danish striker Kasper Høgh from Norwegian champions Bodø/Glimt. The Hoops have reportedly agreed to a deal exceeding £11 million for the prolific forward.

Celtic manager Martin O'Neill has confirmed that negotiations are at an advanced stage, and Høgh is expected to undergo a medical examination within the next 24 hours. This swift action by the Scottish champions comes as they look to fill the void left by Daizen Maeda, who recently completed a transfer to Ipswich Town.

The potential arrival of Høgh is seen as a crucial step for Celtic to refresh their attacking lineup. His age and considerable potential for further development were key factors in making him a priority target for the club, as they aim to maintain their competitive edge.

articles.headline: Casemiro Debuts as Suarez Secures Inter Miami Victory Amidst Injury Scare
articles.summary: Inter Miami clinched a narrow 1-0 road win against CF Montréal, highlighted by Casemiro's highly anticipated MLS debut. However, the match was overshadowed by a concerning head injury to Miami forward German Berterame.
articles.body:
Inter Miami extended their impressive winning run to six matches, securing a hard-fought 1-0 victory over CF Montréal on Saturday, July 25. The match marked a significant occasion with Brazilian midfielder Casemiro making his first appearance for the club, effectively dictating play from the midfield.

The decisive goal arrived in the 81st minute when veteran striker Luis Suarez calmly converted a penalty kick, ensuring Miami collected all three points. This goal further solidified Suarez's strong individual form, taking his season tally to nine goals. Star player Lionel Messi was not in the squad, continuing his post-World Cup recovery period.

Despite the victory, the game was marred by a serious head injury sustained by Miami's Mexican international German Berterame following an aerial collision with Montréal's Efrain Morales. Berterame received immediate medical attention on the field and was later transported by ambulance, though coach Guillermo Hoyos provided a reassuring update, confirming the player was conscious and stable.

articles.headline: Real Madrid Closes In on Leipzig Starlet Yan Diomande After Personal Terms Agreed
articles.summary: Real Madrid has reportedly secured a verbal agreement on personal terms with highly-rated RB Leipzig winger Yan Diomande, signaling a significant step in their pursuit of the Ivorian talent. Despite an initial substantial offer being rejected, the Spanish giants are preparing an improved bid to finalize the transfer.
articles.body:
Real Madrid is making considerable progress in their quest to sign promising RB Leipzig attacker Yan Diomande, with reports indicating that personal terms have been verbally agreed upon. The 19-year-old Côte d'Ivoire international has given the green light on contractual arrangements, positioning the La Liga powerhouse as a leading contender for his signature. This development follows a similar agreement Diomande reportedly reached with Paris Saint-Germain in June, highlighting the intense competition for the gifted youngster.

While personal terms are settled, securing the winger's release from RB Leipzig remains the next hurdle. Real Madrid's initial bid, valued at approximately €90 million with an additional €10 million in add-ons, was promptly turned down by the German club. Undeterred, the Spanish side is now preparing a revised offer, determined to bring the explosive talent to the Santiago Bernabéu.

Diomande joined Leipzig just a year ago from Leganés for around €20 million and enjoyed a breakthrough 2025-26 Bundesliga season, netting 12 goals and providing nine assists in 33 league appearances. His impressive performances, characterized by blistering pace and exceptional dribbling, were further showcased at the 2026 FIFA World Cup, drawing widespread attention from Europe's elite clubs.
